description.zh: 食物网用箭头画出能量从生产者逐级传给消费者的路径，每级约剩十分之一；移走一个物种的影响沿网传开，食物来源越多越稳；难降解毒物逐级放大。仅为虚构 8 种生物的教学模型。
description.en: A food web uses arrows to show energy passed from producers up through consumers, about a tenth surviving each step; removing a species spreads along the web, more food sources make it sturdier, and persistent poisons magnify level by level. A teaching model of eight fictional organisms.

reason.zh: 每上一个营养级能量只留下传递效率那一小部分，所以金字塔越往上越窄，顶级捕食者数量最少。
reason.en: Each trophic level up keeps only the transfer-efficiency fraction of the energy, so the pyramid narrows upward and top predators are the fewest.

title.zh: 为什么顶级捕食者总是很少？
title.en: Why are top predators always few?
